title: Triangular site, removed
note: Same triangle later: the fence, mast and pad are gone and only the bare dirt outline of the fence line and a few worn patches remain in the grass. Google Earth imagery as of 2026, so the structure appears to have been removed.

title: Triangular fenced site with mast
note: Triangular fenced site with a tall lattice mast or tower on a small concrete pad near the center, fence corner posts at each point, and a separate small post inside. Function unknown (possibly an antenna, instrument or tracking site); not confirmed. Date not recorded.

title: Igloo under construction
note: An earth-covered magazine under construction: the arched barrel is in place with the concrete front wall and apron, and soil has been excavated in a wide oval around it ready to be backfilled. Excavators and dozers are parked along the access road, with several pickups. Google Earth imagery.

title: Isolated igloo-type structure (high resolution)
note: Same structure as the bare mound below, shown with a fabric-like cover, pipes and ducting, small buildings and equipment around it. Training or test use is reported, not confirmed.

title: Chemical agent destruction plant
note: Same plant later: a debris pile at upper left, thinner equipment rows and less piping on the roof, consistent with dismantling.

title: Chemical agent destruction plant
note: Plant with equipment, piping and the full row of units still in place.

title: Igloo field and plant overview
note: About 60 earth-covered magazines on a loop road, the plant at right, a rail line along the south edge and several bare tan mounds along the top.

title: Munitions destruction area
note: Two round gravel pads, a cleared scarred area with a small pond, and a large bare area with two ponds beside Muddy Creek.

title: Isolated igloo-type structure (earlier view)
note: Same structure as the high-resolution entry above, here a bare rounded earth mound with a small shed and a long container beside it. Date not recorded.
